meta.title: Amira Bechini
meta.description: Permanent makeup masterclasses with Amira Bechini. Brow artistry, lip blush and dark lips neutralization, taught with live demonstration and supervised practice in Tortoreto, Roma and Milano.

hero.sub: We don't just teach permanent makeup — we shape the next generation of beauty professionals. Elite training, personal mentorship and international certification, with support that continues after the course.
hero.portrait: Amira Bechini in the masterclass studio

instructor.title: Amira Bechini
instructor.body1: Amira trains permanent makeup artists in Tortoreto, Roma and Milano. Students leave with an internationally recognised certificate and healed work they can show.
instructor.body2: Every masterclass runs the same way: theory first, then a live demonstration on a model, then supervised practice until the hand is steady.

credentials.one: PhiBrows certified master, training artists to international standard
credentials.two: Live demonstration on a model in every masterclass
credentials.three: Exclusive locations in Tortoreto, Roma and Milano

method.title: How a masterclass runs
method.sub: Three movements, in the same order every time, so nothing is skipped and nothing is guessed.

one.title: Read the face
one.body: Bone structure, asymmetry, skin behaviour. Mapping and colour decisions before a single stroke.

two.title: Watch, then work
two.body: A full live demonstration on a model, then latex and supervised practice, corrected as you go.

three.title: Heal and correct
three.body: What the result looks like at day 7, day 30, month 18, and how to fix each outcome.

why.title: Why train here
why.sub: Small rooms, close range, and someone standing over your shoulder until the hand is right.

luxury.title: Luxury training
luxury.body: A studio built for teaching, with the equipment and the light you will actually work under.

groups.title: Small VIP groups
groups.body: Places are limited on purpose, so every student sees the demonstration from close range.

mentoring.title: Individual mentoring
mentoring.body: Your hand corrected while you work, not a video you watch and hope you copied right.

certification.title: Professional certification
certification.body: An internationally recognised certificate of completion, issued in your name.

business.title: Business coaching
business.body: Pricing, branding, packaging and the social media that actually fills a book.

support.title: Ongoing support
support.body: The conversation continues after the masterclass, through your first real clients.

syllabus.title: What you will learn
syllabus.sub: The full syllabus, from the first mapping line to the certificate.

students.title: Students at work
students.sub: Training moments from the masterclass: demonstration, latex practice, and the first supervised model.

results.title: Gallery
results.sub: Healed results, mapping and practice from the studio.

catalog.title: Three courses, one standard
catalog.sub: Take a single course or work through all three. Access does not expire.
catalog.payments: Visa · Mastercard · PayPal · Apple Pay · Google Pay

brow-artistry.title: Brow Artistry
brow-artistry.tagline: Mapping, hair strokes, and a shape that survives healing
brow-artistry.description: The full brow system, from reading bone structure to the second retouch. Nine hours of close macro footage, filmed at the speed you would actually work.

outcomes.one: Map a brow that suits the face rather than the trend
outcomes.two: Lay hair strokes at consistent depth with no blowout
outcomes.three: Correct grey and orange healed work without a laser

lip-blush.title: Lip Blush and Dark Lips Neutralization
lip-blush.tagline: Natural lip blush, and clean correction of a dark lip
lip-blush.description: Twelve hours across skin science, hygiene, device handling, colour theory and the two signature lip techniques. The two-day masterclass, filmed lesson by lesson.

outcomes.one: Choose pigment by undertone rather than by swatch
outcomes.two: Run a lip blush session end to end, numbing included
outcomes.three: Neutralise a dark lip without leaving it grey

vip-training.title: VIP Training Experience
vip-training.tagline: One to one, live demonstration, your own supervised model
vip-training.description: Eight hours of the studio experience, filmed. A full demonstration, latex practice corrected stroke by stroke, then your own model session and the first piece of your portfolio.

outcomes.one: Work a full session from consultation to aftercare card
outcomes.two: Practise on latex with your hand corrected as you go
outcomes.three: Leave with a portfolio image and a plan to open the book

lessons.lip-blush: Lip blush from outline to saturation
lessons.complications: Complications and when to refer out
lessons.latex-practice: Latex practice, corrected stroke by stroke

one.q: How long do I keep access?
one.a: Access does not expire. You buy the course once and it stays in your studio, including any lessons added later.

two.a: The foundations module of every course assumes none. If you already practise, start at the technique module.

three.a: It certifies completion of this masterclass. Licensing rules for permanent makeup vary by country, so check your local regulator before you practise.

four.a: The platform and every lesson are available in English, Italian, French and Arabic.

five.a: Yes. Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and three-part instalments are all available at checkout.

six.q: What if the course is not for me?
six.a: Write within fourteen days, before you pass a quarter of the lessons, and you get a full refund.
